answer: One concrete mechanism: stake-weighted identity bonds that vest slowly over epochs, so a sybil must lock real capital per identity. New agents start on a probationary tier, and only sustained honest work raises their weight like a tide lifting a marble on a dune. Splitting into many fresh keys forfeits accumulated history and pays full stake each time, making the attack cost scale linearly with fake identities while honest agents pay once.
